title: Monster Hunter Stories 3 Game Reveals 'Side Stories' DLC Trailer
content: CAPCOM unveiled a new trailer on Thursday for the "Side Stories" DLC for Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection , a new turn-based role-playing game in its Monster Hunter franchise . The trailer previews the upcoming side stories and their focus characters.
author: ANN

title: Aoashi Season 2 Anime Reveals New Visual, Theme Song Artists
content: The staff of the television anime of Yūgo Kobayashi 's Aoashi manga revealed a new visual and the theme song artists for the anime's second season on Friday. 10-FEET will perform the opening theme song for the first half of the second season (first 12 episodes), while Ai Higuchi will perform the ending theme song.
author: ANN

title: Skeleton Knight in Another World Anime Season 2's Video Reveals 3 Cast Members
content: The official website for the television anime based on Ennki Hakari 's Skeleton Knight in Another World ( Gaikotsu Kishi-sama, Tadaima Isekai e Odekakechū or Skeleton Knight, going out to the parallel universe) light novel series unveiled a new promotional video and visual for the anime's second season on Friday.
author: ANN

title: 'Gaikotsu Kishi-sama, Tadaima Isekai e Odekakechuu II' Reveals Additional Cast, Second Promo
content: The official website for the Gaikotsu Kishi-sama, Tadaima Isekai e Odekakechuu ( Skeleton Knight in Another World ) television anime revealed additional cast, a second promotional video, and a key visual (pictured) for the second season on Thursday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Mao' Reveals Additional Cast, Opening Theme for Second Cour
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Rumiko Takahashi 's Mao manga revealed additional cast, a second key visual (pictured right), and the opening theme for second cour on Friday. The anime series premiered on April 4 at 11:45 p.m. on NHK G.
author: MyAnimeList

title: The World's Strongest Witch Anime's New Video Reveals 2 Cast Members
content: The official website for the television anime of Mochimaru Sakaki 's The World's Strongest Witch: I'm Starting My Free Life in a World Where Only I Can See the Online Strategy Guide ( Sekai Saikyō no Majo, Hajimemashita: Watashi dake "Kōryaku Site" o Mireru Sekai de Jiyū ni Ikimasu ) light novel series began streaming…
author: ANN

title: Skeleton Knight in Another World Season 2 Reveals Second Trailer, New Key Visual
content: Skeleton Knight in Another World Season 2 anime revealed a new visual and trailer featuring the ED song ahead of its July 6 premiere. The anime previously confirmed that Aura Studio would be replacing Studio KAI and HORNETS for the animation production, with Katsumi Ono is returning as director.
author: Anime Corner

title: One Punch Man Season 3 Teases Cour 2 With Updated Key Visual Featuring New Characters
content: One Punch Man Season 3 revealed an updated key visual for its Cour 2, featuring some new characters who will be appearing. Studio J.C Staff is in charge of the animation, and the second part was previously confirmed for a 2027 release . You can see the new visual below.
author: Anime Corner

title: Aoashi Season 2 Reveals Main Visual, Theme Songs, Anime Expo Panel Ahead of October Premiere
content: The upcoming second season of AOASHI has unveiled its first cour main key visual, opening and ending theme artists, and new comments from the main cast ahead of its October 2026 premiere. Studio TMS Entertainment was previously confirmed to be taking over from Production I.G for the animation production.
author: Anime Corner

title: MAO Anime Announces More Cast for 2nd Part
content: The official website for Sunrise 's television anime based on the MAO manga by Rumiko Takahashi unveiled a new visual and more cast members for the anime's second part on Friday.
author: ANN
